editorial.title: How to turn player choices into memorable consequences
editorial.intro: A good consequence feels inevitable in hindsight. It follows from what happened, who noticed, and what they can actually do about it.

items.title: Coherence over punishment
items.body: Consequences should match the action, not just tax the players. A spared enemy can become a debt, a rumor, or an unexpected ally.

items.title: People react to what they know
items.body: NPCs and factions only respond to what they witnessed, deduced, or were told. Hidden deeds stay hidden until someone finds a thread.

items.title: Leave doors open
items.body: A consequence can create a job, a bargain, a sanctuary, or a new route through the world — not only a cost.

items.title: Let the future arrive
items.body: Something that ripples into next session, or a season later, makes the setting feel alive instead of reset between games.

items.name: Rumor Generator
items.blurb: Half-true whispers that factions already believe.

items.name: Complication Generator
items.blurb: Pressure that complicates a plan without shutting it down.

items.name: Quest Generator
items.blurb: Jobs that grow out of earlier choices, not random bulletin boards.

about.title: About PlotRipple
about.lead: PlotRipple is an international portal of free tools for tabletop RPG game masters. The first tool turns a player decision into structured narrative consequences.
body: It is built for traffic and useful craft, not as a SaaS product. There is no account, no campaign database, and no subscription.
The generator is system-agnostic. It does not teach or enforce the rules of any published game.
Later tools will follow the same idea: small, focused aids you can use between sessions or at the table.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.draftNotice: This page is an initial draft. It is not a substitute for legal review.

sections.title: What you type
sections.body: The description you submit is sent to an external AI service so the generator can return consequences. Do not enter personal, confidential, or sensitive information. Treat the field as fiction for the table, not as a place for real names, contact details, or private facts.

sections.title: Local history
sections.body: The last few generations may be stored in your browser on this device so you can reopen them. That history is not uploaded automatically.

sections.title: Analytics and ads
sections.body: Analytics and advertising may be configured later. If they are enabled, they will not include the text you typed or the generated story text.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.draftNotice: This page is an initial draft. It is not legal advice and does not replace a reviewed agreement.

sections.title: The tools are free drafts
sections.body: PlotRipple provides free, experimental writing aids for game masters. Generated text is a starting point. You decide what reaches the table.

sections.title: No accounts
sections.body: You can use the generator without creating an account. We do not store campaigns or user profiles on a server for this MVP.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not use the generator to create or seek illegal content, to submit other people’s personal data, or to overload the service.

sections.title: Availability
sections.body: The service may change, pause, or apply usage limits. AI output can be wrong, uneven, or unusable for your table.

footer.rights: A narrative workshop for game masters.
